description: Window dragging for the SPA served by the local Python server. With an Overlay titlebar the webview covers the whole title area, so macOS no longer offers a draggable strip of its own — the page must nominate one with data-tauri-drag-region, and Tauri implements that over IPC (invoke 'plugin:window|start_dragging'). The `default` capability deliberately leaves IPC inert on this origin, so this grants the two window-movement commands and nothing else: the entire surface exposed is moving and zooming the window the user is already looking at.
